questions.stem: How does sweating help cool the body down?

options.text: Sweat absorbs heat from the body as it evaporates from the skin surface
Sweat carries waste products out of the body
Sweat blocks sunlight from reaching the skin
Sweat causes vasoconstriction to reduce heat production

questions.explanation: When sweat evaporates from the skin surface, it uses heat energy from the body to change from liquid to gas. This transfer of heat energy cools the body down.
